main.description: Top-level Request For Proposal (RFP). Envelope that strongRefs a domain-specific payload (e.g. compute.vm).

payload.description: Strong reference to the domain-specific payload record (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.vm).

submitBid.description: Service DID reference (did:web:HOST#temp_market) of the RFP issuer's market service. Optional; bypasses the need for bids to be seen in the firehose. The bidder calls com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.submitBid via PDS service-proxying using this value as the atproto-proxy target.
